recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No follow-up is needed unless a future publisher regression reintroduces null-prefixed DomainResource section numbering.
issue_request: FHIR-5366 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 non-substantive correction for the FHIR-core documentation page. The ballot comment reported that clicking the Domain Resource link under Infrastructure Types produced subsection headings prefixed with "null", such as "null.1 Scope and Usage"; the resolution was to fix the broken hierarchy/index.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-5366 was found. The closest application evidence is 1f47641cdc1dfceffec70ed5fbb20c0957674289 from 2015-03-12, whose message says it fixed the hierarchy and whose patch moved DomainResource into the documentation hierarchy. Jira comments on 2015-03-14 say the issue was already fixed.
additional_context: The old "Infrastructure Types" presentation has been reorganized into the current Type Framework area. DomainResource is actively registered in source/hierarchy.xml and in source/fhir.ini as an infrastructure abstract resource, and build.fhir.org renders numeric DomainResource section counts rather than null-prefixed counts.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The authoritative source headings and current generated page surface no longer contain the reported null-prefixed section-numbering defect.
